reference: T010 real-device proof through the same formal typed transport used by the candidate (`createTransport` over the generated contract): with a session credential issued by the actual local isolated non-production backend, `GET /api/v1/me` returns 200 with a MeResponse, and with no credential at all it returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED as a typed HTTP error. The transport ran on an actual iPhone through WeChat DevTools 真机调试 over LAN, not the Simulator; the credential stayed in device memory and never appeared in source, screenshots, logs, evidence or the repository.

design.selector: Real-device Acceptance 记录设备/系统/微信/基础库/DevTools、构建、后端环境、操作、实际结果以及相关缺陷。

environment: Device: iPhone 16 (iPhone17,3), iOS 26.6.2, WeChat 8.0.80; runtime base library SDK 3.18.1 read in-app via wx.getAppBaseInfo().SDKVersion. Runtime path: WeChat DevTools cask 2.02.2609250 (app build 36.6.0) 真机调试 over LAN, not the Simulator. Probe server: Node 26.13.0 on macOS 26.6.2 arm64 listening on http://192.168.2.135:8791 (all interfaces), logging the peer address and User-Agent; phone peer 192.168.2.212, UA MicroMessenger/8.0.80 NetType/WIFI. AppID wx746a39363f67ae95. Isolated technical probe only: no backend, production service, real family data, or production credentials involved. Backend: local isolated non-production instance from the read-only pyxm1618/xiaoshuyin checkout at commit 9c3a3c6d3e7c84aecf706f80a5329abf786e8e17 (branch feat/023-reranker-provider-adapter-foundation), Fastify API on http://192.168.2.135:8788 backed by an isolated PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector database with ephemeral local secrets; no production database, production credentials or real personal data involved. The frozen generated contract at that commit hash-matches the frontend pinned contract: packages/generated/openapi.json sha256 9ce501df305fd767b37d6831d09ef94ebc60eac435b18f820958c868c96e6903 and packages/generated/openapi.d.ts sha256 ddfac7b93787c1ec9a4ba370ee8c699a1230cb0f74f3fd17aee1b4e37690630d, identical to .specify/contract-source.json. The synthetic account was created through the backend own development fake code2session provider. The backend repository was not modified; no backend PR, contract change or production data access was performed. The checkout later advanced on its own branch for unrelated work, while the isolated API process started from the recorded commit continued serving the captured requests. The retained sanitized log contains request-line fields only; authorization/cookie/user-agent are redacted by the backend logger, and no credential or token is present in any artifact.

operations.action: Open the backend identity probe page on the phone and run it through the formal typed transport
operations.expected: The transport performs the synthetic WeChat login against the actual backend and keeps the issued session credential in memory only
operations.actual: Server logged POST /api/v1/auth/wechat 200 for req-7 at 08:41:12Z from host 192.168.2.135:8788; the page reported login PASS and printed only "token=issued", never the token value

operations.action: Call GET /api/v1/me with the issued credential through the same transport
operations.expected: A 200 response typed as MeResponse with an ACTIVE account and a person id, delivered as transport data
operations.actual: PASS status=200 accountStatus=ACTIVE person.id present (string); server logged GET /api/v1/me 200 for req-8

operations.action: Call GET /api/v1/me with no credential at all (not a wrong token)
operations.expected: The backend rejects the request with 401 and the transport surfaces it as a typed HTTP error with code UNAUTHENTICATED
operations.actual: PASS kind=http status=401 code=UNAUTHENTICATED; server logged GET /api/v1/me 401 for req-9

operations.action: Read the on-screen results and capture device media
operations.expected: The phone shows platform ios, the actual device model and all three outcomes, and a real-device screenshot is retained without any credential
operations.actual: Screenshot at 16:43 local (1179x2556) shows platform ios, model iPhone 16<iPhone17,3>, PASS login, PASS /me 200 ACTIVE and PASS /me 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; no token or personal data visible
